name: loom
description: Codex-native Loom and dag-executor skills for exploration, planning, decomposition, implementation, cleanup, review, explicit risk scanning, and supervised runs.

interface.shortDescription: Use Loom and dag-executor workflows in Codex
interface.longDescription: Loom provides Codex-native skills for exploring feature ideas, writing specs and plans, decomposing work into DAGs, running supervised implementations, cleaning up changes, simplifying code, running fan-out code review, and explicitly scanning adjacent project code for verified risks.
defaultPrompt: Explore this feature idea and write a spec.
Create a plan from the latest spec.
Decompose this plan into a DAG.
Risk scan the code adjacent to these changes.
